title: Taskfold · progress
headline: The agreed P1 batch is complete. P2 and account-deletion follow-up remain.
focus: P0 · Deletion-recovery coordination verified in scoped checks
latest: Current app processes now coordinate the private deletion journal without losing another account’s pending work. The iPhone Store passes finished-elsewhere cleanup, expired retry and account-switch scenarios (32 / 17 / 19 assertions); both repos pass 30 focused Core checks and both apps build. Mac runtime stopped at a protected Keychain write and remains unaccepted. Expired pre-proof recovery and residual-file repair remain open. P2 migration remains unfinished and gated.
next: Return to the subtask-storage migration: finish other operation Redo/shared history, older-data mapping and shared file/discussion custody. Deliver and accept one complete workflow at a time.
Finish genuine Mac protected-Keychain/deletion acceptance and the remaining legacy-attempt/residual-file recovery work. Do not erase copies when server removal is unprovable.
Keep the agreed rollout, provider, distribution, dictation and physical-device deferrals paused.
